_comment: UNIRA V6.7 30-year transition. Targets = comfortable levels (v65/thresholds). Capacities: energy from solar+wind build (v66/ecology: 2025 record 669 GW; 1.5C path needs 1.1-1.3 TW/yr; blended capacity factor 0.186 from the 2025 mix), health from v66 training plan, housing from v66/construction/capacity.json.

low._note: record solar+wind pace (0.67 TW/yr); half of world home building goes to regions below 27 m2

central._note: 1.2 TW/yr; 75% of home building to regions below target (One Earth allocation)

high._note: 1.8 TW/yr; 90% of home building to regions below target

central_no_wars._note: central + rule 19: military energy (5.5% of world, Parkinson & Cottrell 2022, REPORTED_NEEDS_RECHECK) freed over 5 years in regions above target; rich-region decline 3%/yr instead of 4%

evidence_classes.excess_decline: SYNTHETIC_ASSUMPTION; 4%/yr is the slowest tested rate keeping world final energy at or below today's 409 EJ (inside the IPCC AR6 1.5C range) while poorer regions converge
